599:t_006:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Fine. Then I'll enjoy myself however I please.」

599:t_006:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll take all of you on, $$バルビエル$$!」

599:t_006:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「I've seen enough of your creepy smile and that gloomy machine of yours!」

599:t_006:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll repay everything you've done to us, right here!」

599:t_006:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire...」

599:t_006:8.en:
$n
「Why are you saying those words here...?」

599:t_006:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come, $$ガン・アーレス$$. Let's teach these foolish Earthlings their place!」

599:t_007:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What is going on...!? My power... should be greater than this!」

599:t_007:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's true. He wasn't as much of a threat today as he usually is.」

599:t_007:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Did $$セツコ$$'s $$悲しみの乙女$$ seal his power...?」

599:t_007:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That can't be! My hatred...!」

599:t_008:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Let us admit it, $$バルビエル$$.」

599:t_008:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you've come to help $$バルビエル$$!」

599:t_008:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, I have not. I have come to collect $$バルビエル$$.」

599:t_008:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$サルディアス$$! You bastard!!」

599:t_009:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$サルディアス$$ was shot!」

599:t_009:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck!? Are they fighting each other!?」

599:t_009:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Your performance is indeed lacking. At least when I fought you before, it was far greater than this.」

599:t_009:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「This is unlike you, $$バルビエル$$. Empathizing with the pilots of $$ガンダム$$s...」

599:t_009:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why would that scorpion bastard empathize with $$ガンダム$$ pilots...!?」

599:t_009:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I imagine he saw a reflection of his own circumstances in them.」

599:t_009:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「After all, the true name of $$バルビエル$$'s machine is $$ガン・アーレス$$.」

599:t_009:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ガンダム$$... $$ガンバスター$$... and $$ガン・アーレス$$...」

599:t_009:11.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Why are you bringing up $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ here!?」

599:t_009:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Why are you bringing up $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ here!?」

599:t_009:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Why are you bringing up $$ノリコ$$'s $$ガンバスター$$ here!?」

599:t_009:14.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As expected of you, $$ゼロ$$. It seems you had noticed.」

599:t_009:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You are correct. Those machines, including $$ガン・アーレス$$, are what we call products of the civilization of fire.」

599:t_009:17.en:
$n
「Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire...」

599:t_009:18.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「They all indicate paths to $$シンカ$$. And all of them have gathered in $c, across space and time.」

599:t_009:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Blood of the beast...」

599:t_009:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It is the most primal instinct sleeping within humans... To fight to live, and to win to live.」

599:t_009:22.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems your contact with those who walk that path awakened the blood within you.」

599:t_009:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「That's what inheriting the $$ダンクーガ$$ means...」

599:t_009:24.en:
$$葵$$
「So our seniors are the reason our wild instincts awakened...」

599:t_009:27.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Do you mean the $$アクエリオン$$!?」

599:t_009:28.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「A Mechanical Angel named for pure water... It signifies different things melting into one and becoming clear.」

599:t_009:29.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Humans and $$天翅$$... men and women...」

599:t_009:30.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「They melt together within the $$アクエリオン$$...」

599:t_009:31.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Destination of the wind...」

599:t_009:33.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The spiral swirls and calls forth wind. That wind always seeks new lands as its heart desires, never remaining still.」

599:t_009:34.en:
$$シモン$$
「From underground $$ジーハ村$$ to the edge of the galaxy... My $$螺旋力$$ has always smashed through the walls in its way...」

599:t_009:35.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The three you have described were brought by visitors from other worlds when the multiverse was born...」

599:t_009:36.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Exactly. Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, and destination of the wind were called here to advance the civilization of fire.」

599:t_009:38.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And the civilization of fire... It is the gathering of humanity's wisdom.」

599:t_009:39.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It calls forth battle, and humanity advances within it. With their machines, people overcome enemies... obstacles... for the future they believe in.」

599:t_009:40.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Machines bearing the name 'Gun' are its proof... This world is now at the end of the civilization of fire, and you were gathered here for that reason.」

599:t_009:41.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes... to advance into a new era.」

599:t_009:43.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The $$ガンバスター$$ opens the way to the future...」

599:t_009:45.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「He, too, fought invaders alongside $$ガン・アーレス$$, on an Earth different from this one.」

599:t_009:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バルビエル$$... is from Earth, too...?」

599:t_009:48.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Exactly. Of course, he did not go by the name $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ back then.」

599:t_009:49.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Incidentally, I... was his enemy at the time.」

599:t_009:50.en:
$$万丈$$
「So $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ was fighting $$サイデリアル$$.」

599:t_009:52.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It was destroyed by $$サイデリアル$$.」

599:t_009:53.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「He is the last survivor of that Earth.」

599:t_009:55.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「His anger and sorrow became hatred, and he finally awakened $$ガン・アーレス$$'s $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$ $$スフィア$$ completely.」

599:t_009:56.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As a result, everyone in my unit except me was wiped out.」

599:t_009:57.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... He saw his own memories in the $$ガンダム$$s, which bear the same destiny of the civilization of fire.」

599:t_009:58.en:
$$シャア$$
「That weakened his hatred, preventing him from using his usual power...」

599:t_009:59.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That is merely speculation...」

599:t_009:60.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I have often wondered whether humans can truly pursue the emotion of hatred to its end.」

599:t_009:62.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Time and new encounters heal wounds... And people can move forward because they can forget hatred... their past.」
